params.body:
## Why

The damage tab was the other Bootstrap island on the vehicle sheet. Its layout was a `.row`
with two `col-md-8` columns, the diagram markers were `.btn btn-circle-lg btn-circle`, the
damage list was `.row.m-t-25` with `col-lg-3 col-sm-4 col-xs-12` cards, and every small action
was a `.btn btn-circle-xs/sm btn-circle btn-info|btn-danger`. `refresh.css` then spent four
separate copies putting the colour back, because the house rules make `btn-info` and
`btn-danger` deliberately quiet white. Markup and that layer only move together.

Behaviour is unchanged. Ids, names, data attributes, handlers and element order are kept;
only layout and colour classes changed.

Two things this made visible and fixed on the way:
- `btn-circle-lg` does not exist in the theme, so the "large circles" were 40x40 squares with
  an 8px radius (the house `.btn` rule beats `btn-circle`'s `border-radius: 100%`). The new
  rule says 40x40 at 8px, which is what is on screen.
- `.ui-damage-edit` and three `p > a.btn-danger` rules matched nothing any more since the
  actions moved into `.ui-damage-actions`. Removed.

## What per view

- `_tabs/damage.blade.php` — `.row` + two `col-md-8` become `ui-damage-layout` (one column,
  two equal columns from 992px). Two `col-md-8` columns meant a tablet got two 66% columns
  that wrapped anyway, each wasting a third of the width. The diagram markers keep their
  state classes (`btn-warning` / `btn-secondary` / `btn-info`, swapped by `vehicle.js`) and
  drop the theme's shape classes; the shape now lives in `.ui-edit .car_explosion_button`.
  The note textarea drops `form-control` and so gets the same field styling as the other
  panes (`--brand-field` instead of the old `#fafbfc`). The save link becomes
  `ui-button ui-button--primary`.
- `_tabs/damages.blade.php` — `.row.m-t-25` becomes `ui-damages-grid` (the CSS already turned
  it into a grid, keyed on the Bootstrap class), the cards drop their `col-*`/`m-b-25`, and
  edit and delete become `ui-mini-btn ui-mini-btn--edit|--danger`.
- `_tabs/_damage_media.blade.php` — same two buttons on the modal tiles.

## JS hooks kept

`car_explosion`, `car_explosion_image`, `car_explosion_button`, `button_{1..18}`,
`btn-warning` / `btn-secondary` / `btn-info` as marker states, `car_explosion_textarea_div_{i}`,
`car_explosion_textarea_{i}`, `d-none`, `textfields`, `dropzone` + `damage_images_{i}` with
`data-damage-id` and `data-positie`, `damage_images_button_{i}`, `ui-damage-media`,
`ui-dm-tile`, `modal_damage_media_{id}`, `damage_media_{id}`, `damage_thumbnail_{id}`,
`image_block_{id}`, `damage_block` with `data-location`, `ui-damage-actions`,
`ui-media-actions`, `edit_button`, `#damages`, `ui-damages-list`, `last_selected_damage`,
`ui-damage-backdrop`, and the `car_damage[]` field name. `showTextArea`, `addDamage`,
`recolorDamageButtons`, `deleteDamage`, `owConfirmDeleteDamage`, `owCloseDamage`, the
`#damages` MutationObserver and the Livewire island behind `wire:ignore` all keep working on
the same selectors. `damages.blade.php` and `_damage_media.blade.php` are also rendered
server-side by `OwnStockController::addDamage`, so they had to keep matching what the page
already has.

## CSS

- Added: `.ui-mini-btn` with `--edit` and `--danger` (one base for the small round action
  buttons on a damage card, a damage photo and a modal tile), `.ui-damage-layout`, and the
  shape of `.ui-edit .car_explosion_button`.
- Rekeyed from theme classes to `.ui-mini-btn` / `.ui-mini-btn--edit` / `.ui-mini-btn--danger`:
  the damage-media rules (both generations), the `#damages` action and media groups, the icon
  size rule, the `.ui-dm-tile` overlay, and the `.ui-damages-list` photo rules. `.row.m-t-25`
  became `.ui-damages-grid`; `.ui-damage-footer .btn` became `.ui-damage-footer .ui-button`.
- Removed: eight colour lines that only put back what `btn-info` / `btn-danger` took away, the
  dead `.btn-success` rule and the two dead `p > a.btn-danger` blocks.
- Two links here have no `href`, and Bootstrap's reboot (`a:not([href]):not([tabindex])`)
  beats a plain class, which is what `.text-white` used to paper over; the base and the footer
  rule now say the colour with a selector that wins.

## Screenshots

Damage tab before/after at 1280 and 390, plus the damage modal open at both widths. Geometry
and colour measured identical on both sides: markers 40x40 at 8px (white, amber when there is
damage), the "extra damage" pill 130x41, the card grid `285.5px 285.5px` with a 12px gap, the
photo 116x88, the action buttons 28/26/30px in their three places, blue `rgb(10,143,212)` and
red `rgb(192,57,43)` with a white icon, the save button 516x44 blue on white.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` + `php -l` on every compiled view
- `npm run build`
- `SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|VehicleForm|Vehicle|Photo|Damage|DemoMedia`: 231 tests green (1 skipped)

Rebased on main after #265 (photo tab) landed; the two touch different regions of `refresh.css`.
params.title: Damage tab of the vehicle sheet in the ui vocabulary
